Kathryn Fox, who practices law in Walnut Creek, California, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of San Francisco School of Law. She graduated in 1986. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1986.
